# hippobase_auth_server

Purpose: Native-free Dart authentication server compatible with existing Better Auth data.

Read first:
- README.md
- lib/src/server.dart
- lib/src/router/router.dart
- ../hippobase_auth_server_engine/README.md
- ../hippobase_auth_server_sql/README.md
- ../hippobase_auth_server_oidc/README.md

Main implementation:
- lib/src/router/
- lib/src/guard.dart
- lib/src/utils/

Validation:
- dart analyze
- dart test --concurrency=1
